notes:
REF-BM-02: Save does not fetch page metadata, favicon, or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after saving, but they are not auto-collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs create additional bookmarks instead of converging on the existing item.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but not notes.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and will not match stored tag names.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are always sorted by creation date descending; no sort key can be selected.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is unsupported.
REF-BM-27: There is no reversible archive operation distinct from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are available.
